product_one_liner.value: HAAS Alert's Safety Cloud delivers digital roadway-hazard alerts from emergency and roadway fleets to drivers through connected vehicles and navigation apps.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing pages cover public safety, towing, and construction/utilities.

named_customers.notes: WJ Group has a Safety Cloud case study; the integrations page describes Irondale Fire's activation of Safety Cloud.

employee_band.notes: Based on a reported headcount of 56; headcount estimates can vary by source.

eng_blog.notes: The public index shows product updates, safety explainers and promotional content, rather than at least two engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: A public knowledge base contains product categories and articles including a transponder installation guide and general FAQ.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Listed openings are RevOps Manager / GTM Engineer, Product Manager, and Technical Delivery & Solutions Lead; none has a qualifying AI/ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No model or provider powering the product was disclosed in the documentation, blog, trust or privacy materials reviewed.

compliance_certs.notes: The company claims these three; its privacy policy specifically states completion of SOC 2 Type 1 and Type 2 audits. GDPR is a compliance claim rather than an audit certification.

last_funding.notes: Latest announced funding located: a $50,000 Detroit Startup Fund Scale Grant, announced April 17, 2026. This is non-equity grant funding, not a venture round; the latest investment round located was Volition Capital's January 2024 growth investment, with amount undisclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: Counting non-equity funding: HAAS Alert announced receipt of a $50,000 Scale Grant on April 17, 2026, within the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: None of the listed openings is an SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Safety Cloud for Android Automotive launched June 2, 2026. The August 5, 2026 update also introduced the Safety Cloud mobile app.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brock Aun became Chief Strategy Officer in July 2026, moving internally from VP of Product. This was a C-suite appointment through promotion, not an external hire.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The RevOps posting explicitly identifies these as its existing stack.
